predictions.headline: Minnesota's stronger season record earns a narrow High-grade away lean
predictions.text: Moneyline: Minnesota Wild. Minnesota bring a 6–2–2 record into Calgary, while the Flames are 2–6–0. The Wild's latest game was a 4–3 overtime loss at Edmonton on 20 October, so this is not a winning-streak claim; the edge comes from the stronger season record. Calgary did beat Carolina 3–2 on 18 October, but the official figures still make Minnesota a narrow High-grade away selection at 70.8% (1.41 fair decimal).

facts.claim: Official records for game 2026020162: Minnesota 6–2–2; Calgary 2–6–0
Minnesota lost 4–3 in overtime at Edmonton on 20 October
Calgary beat Carolina 3–2 on 18 October after earlier losses including 6–2 at Vegas

predictions.headline: Aurillac's consecutive wins contrast with winless Nevers
predictions.text: Match winner: Stade Aurillacois. Aurillac have climbed to ninth in Pro D2 with three wins from seven and arrive on back-to-back league victories. Nevers remain bottom and winless after seven rounds, with 146 points scored and 222 conceded. At Stade Jean Alric on 23 October, the official table supports Aurillac at 70.5% (1.42 fair decimal), although their own 240–254 points record argues against extending this to a handicap selection.

facts.claim: Aurillac are ninth at 3W–0D–4L, 240:254, with two straight wins; Nevers are 16th at 0W–0D–7L, 146:222
Aurillac host Nevers on 23 October at Stade Jean Alric

predictions.headline: Connacht's comparative edge comes against winless Zebre
predictions.text: Match winner: Connacht Rugby. Connacht have one win from three URC rounds and are coming off a 36–19 defeat at Glasgow, so the case is comparative rather than a winning-streak claim. Zebre remain winless after three matches, conceding 116 points while scoring 52, and lost 29–12 to Edinburgh in their latest recorded outing. At Dexcom Stadium, those official figures give Connacht a narrow High-grade edge at 70.2% (1.42 fair decimal), rather than a stronger handicap position.

facts.claim: Connacht are 1W–0D–2L; Zebre are winless at 0W–0D–3L with 52:116 points
Recent official results include Glasgow 36–19 Connacht and Zebre 12–29 Edinburgh
Connacht host Zebre at Dexcom Stadium on 23 October
